title: NV200 layout
editInstructions: Double-click NV200Interior. Construction group controls wall7, frame18, band/post60 and radius25 mm. Platform height now means top of slats (400 mm baseline), replacing the old bedHeight/foam-top input. Existing footprint, foam, cabinet and visibility values are retained. Enter explicit units. Wheel arches group controls provisional rear offset, length, height, clear width, post clearance and reference visibility. The rear wall-side end support widens automatically to the arch offset minus clearance. Cabinet now shares plywood/frame settings; Cabinet length retains saved outer length. Obsolete inner length is ignored. Cabinet frame height preserves cabinetHeight.
configurationMechanism: Daytime drives both sliding benches and cushions. Show slats controls both benches’ slats, cross-bench lid and plate stops. Show cushions remains independent. Rear drawer extension has its own checkbox.
